guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: SLAC Linac Coherent Light Source
guides.concept: 以 SLAC 的 LCLS 為對象：常溫銅直線加速器以 120 Hz 提供 13.6 GeV 電子，在 112 m 波盪器中以自放大自發輻射（SASE）產生 1.5 Å 的飛秒 X 光脈衝；本課推導 Pierce 參數、增益長度與飽和功率，拆解光陰極注入、束流壓縮與雷射加熱器，再把單發診斷、脈衝統計與 LCLS-II 的 4 GeV 超導連續波直線加速器（最高 1 MHz）整合成可驗收的工程邏輯。
guides.conceptEn: Taking SLAC's LCLS: a normal-conducting copper linac delivers 13.6 GeV electrons at 120 Hz, and a 112 m undulator produces femtosecond 1.5 Å X-ray pulses by self-amplified spontaneous emission (SASE). The course derives the Pierce parameter, gain length and saturation power, works through the photoinjector, bunch compression and laser heater, then integrates single-shot diagnostics, pulse statistics and the LCLS-II 4 GeV superconducting continuous-wave linac (up to 1 MHz) into an acceptable engineering logic.
procedure: LCLS 使用 SLAC 3 km 直線加速器的最後 1 km：2.856 GHz 的銅加速結構以約 17 MV/m 把電子推到 13.6 GeV，但銅壁的射頻損耗極大，只能以微秒級脈衝、120 Hz 重複率運轉。LCLS-II 在隧道前 750 m 裝入 1.3 GHz 鈮超導加速模組，在 2 K 下壁損耗低了五個數量級以上，可以連續波運轉，把重複率推到 1 MHz。兩種直線加速器共用同一個波盪器大廳，重複率、束流功率與光學熱負載因此差了四個數量級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

在波盪器中電子與自身輻射交互作用，密度沿波長方向形成微束團（microbunching），輻射因而相干疊加並指數成長，這就是 SASE。成長率由 Pierce 參數 ρ 決定：ρ 由峰值電流、電子束尺寸、K 值與能量共同給出，典型只有 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級。功率每隔一個增益長度 L_g 增加 e 倍，約 20 個 L_g 後飽和；飽和功率約為 ρ 乘以電子束功率，頻寬也約為 ρ。LCLS 用 33 段共 112 m 的固定間隙波盪器就是為了在 8 keV 附近確保飽和。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「112 m 波盪器與 SASE 增益」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SASE 的共振條件要求整段波盪器的 K 值一致到 ρ 的量級，否則不同段輻射的波長錯開、增益中斷。LCLS 波盪器以 NdFeB 永磁混合磁列組成，K 以微調磁極間隙的斜置機構校正；相鄰段之間的相位整合器（phase shifter）讓電子與光在段間漂移區保持同相；由於 NdFeB 剩磁隨溫度約 −0.1 %/K 變化，波盪器大廳的溫度穩定度直接變成 K 的穩定度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「固定間隙波盪器段（λ_u = 30 mm，K = 3.5）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

高峰值電流來自壓縮：光陰極射頻槍產生約 250 pC、數十安培的束團，在直線加速器中以離峰相位加速得到能量啁啾，再經兩個磁性壓縮器（chicane）讓高能電子走短路徑追上低能電子，把長度壓縮約百倍到 3 kA。壓縮同時放大縱向密度調變與相干同步輻射（CSR）造成的微束團不穩定，所以在注入器加一台雷射加熱器，刻意把能散從幾 keV 提高到約 20 keV 以藍道阻尼抑制不穩定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光陰極射頻槍、雷射加熱器與束流壓縮器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SASE 是由雜訊啟動的隨機過程，每一發的能量、光譜與時間結構都不同，所以 LCLS 的診斷全部必須逐發記錄並與實驗資料同標籤。氣體偵測器以 X 光游離稀薄氣體並收集離子或電子電流，無損地量每發脈衝能量；彎晶單發光譜儀把頻譜展開到條狀偵測器上；時序工具以 X 光在薄膜上誘發的折射率跳變，用啁啾的光學脈衝把 X 光到達時間量到飛秒等級，事後把資料按真實延遲重新排序。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氣體偵測器、單發光譜儀與時序工具」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SASE 脈衝由許多彼此不相干的縱向模式（尖峰）組成，尖峰的持續時間約為同調時間，由頻寬 ρ 決定；脈衝能量的逐發相對抖動近似為 1/√M，M 是模式數。長脈衝含數十到上百個尖峰，抖動只有百分之十幾；把束團壓到只含幾個模式時，抖動升到接近 100%，這正是 LCLS 短脈衝模式必須搭配逐發診斷的統計根源，也是「單尖峰」模式產生完全相干脈衝的原理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「脈衝統計：模式數與能量抖動」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

LCLS-II 在隧道前 750 m 安裝 1.3 GHz 的 TESLA 型超導加速模組（每模組 8 個九腔鈮腔，另加 3.9 GHz 線性化模組），以約 16 MV/m 的連續波梯度把電子加速到 4 GeV；腔體以氮摻雜製程把 Q₀ 提高到 2.7×10¹⁰ 以壓低 2 K 熱負載。模組由 Fermilab 與 Jefferson Lab 組裝、測試後運到 SLAC 串接；2 K 低溫站的容量由所有腔體的動態損耗加靜態漏熱決定，再乘上 2 K 制冷的效率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「超導加速模組串與 2 K 低溫站」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

1 MHz 連續波束流的平均功率達數百千瓦，任何導向錯誤都會在毫秒內熔穿真空腔，所以機器保護系統（MPS）必須以束流損失監視器、電流差分與溫度感測在百微秒內切斷注入器雷射。使用者驗收規格則包含光子能量範圍、脈衝能量、到達時間抖動、重複率與可用度；每一項都要綁定運轉模式（電荷、壓縮、波盪器設定），因為同一台機器在不同模式下的性能差異很大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「機器保護系統與使用者交付規格」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: LCLS uses the last 1 km of SLAC's 3 km linac: 2.856 GHz copper structures at about 17 MV/m push electrons to 13.6 GeV, but copper wall losses are so large that operation is limited to microsecond pulses at 120 Hz. LCLS-II installs 1.3 GHz niobium superconducting cryomodules in the first 750 m of the tunnel, where wall losses at 2 K are more than five orders of magnitude lower, allowing continuous-wave operation and a repetition rate up to 1 MHz. Both linacs feed the same undulator hall, so repetition rate, beam power and optics heat load differ by four orders of magnitude. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Inside the undulator the electrons interact with their own radiation, the density develops microbunching at the radiation wavelength, and the emission adds coherently and grows exponentially: that is SASE. The growth rate is set by the Pierce parameter ρ, which combines peak current, beam size, K and energy and is typically only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³. Power grows by e every gain length L_g and saturates after about 20 L_g; the saturated power is about ρ times the electron-beam power and the bandwidth is also about ρ. LCLS used 33 fixed-gap segments totalling 112 m precisely to guarantee saturation near 8 keV. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “112 m undulator and SASE gain”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The SASE resonance requires K to be uniform along the whole undulator to the order of ρ, otherwise the segments radiate at different wavelengths and the gain breaks. LCLS undulators are hybrid NdFeB arrays whose K is trimmed by a mechanism that slightly cants the gap; phase shifters between segments keep electrons and light in phase across the drift sections; and because NdFeB remanence changes by about −0.1 %/K, the undulator-hall temperature stability becomes the K stability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fixed-gap undulator segments (λ_u = 30 mm, K = 3.5)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

High peak current comes from compression: the photocathode RF gun produces about 250 pC at tens of amperes, off-crest acceleration imprints an energy chirp, and two magnetic chicanes let high-energy electrons take the shorter path and catch up with low-energy ones, compressing the length about a hundredfold to 3 kA. Compression also amplifies longitudinal density modulations and the coherent-synchrotron-radiation (CSR) driven microbunching instability, so a laser heater in the injector deliberately raises the energy spread from a few keV to about 20 keV to suppress it by Landau damping. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photocathode RF gun, laser heater and bunch compressors”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

SASE starts from noise, so every shot differs in energy, spectrum and time structure, and all LCLS diagnostics must record shot by shot and share tags with the experiment data. Gas detectors ionise dilute gas with the X-rays and collect ion or electron current to measure pulse energy non-destructively; a bent-crystal single-shot spectrometer spreads the spectrum onto a strip detector; and the timing tool uses the X-ray-induced refractive-index step in a thin film, probed by a chirped optical pulse, to measure X-ray arrival time at the femtosecond level so data can be re-sorted by true delay afterwards. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gas detector, single-shot spectrometer and timing tool”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A SASE pulse consists of many mutually incoherent longitudinal modes (spikes); each spike lasts about one coherence time, set by the bandwidth ρ, and the shot-to-shot relative fluctuation of pulse energy is about 1/√M for M modes. A long pulse contains tens to a hundred spikes and fluctuates by only ten-odd percent; compressing the bunch to a few modes drives the fluctuation toward 100%, which is the statistical reason LCLS short-pulse modes need shot-by-shot diagnostics, and also the principle behind single-spike modes that yield fully coherent pulses. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pulse statistics: mode count and energy fluctuation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

LCLS-II installs 1.3 GHz TESLA-type superconducting cryomodules in the first 750 m of the tunnel (eight nine-cell niobium cavities per module, plus 3.9 GHz linearising modules), accelerating electrons to 4 GeV at a continuous-wave gradient of about 16 MV/m; nitrogen doping raises the cavity Q₀ to 2.7×10¹⁰ to limit the 2 K heat load. The modules were assembled and tested at Fermilab and Jefferson Lab and then strung together at SLAC; the 2 K cryoplant capacity follows from the dynamic loss of all cavities plus static heat leak, multiplied by the efficiency of 2 K refrigeration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cryomodule string and the 2 K cryoplant”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A 1 MHz continuous-wave beam carries hundreds of kilowatts of average power, and any steering error would melt through a chamber within milliseconds, so the machine protection system (MPS) must cut the injector laser within about a hundred microseconds using beam-loss monitors, current differencing and temperature sensors. The user-acceptance specification covers photon-energy range, pulse energy, arrival-time jitter, repetition rate and availability, each bound to an operating mode (charge, compression, undulator settings) because the same machine performs very differently across modes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Machine protection and user-delivery specification”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若把 120 Hz 時代的光學與偵測器直接接到 1 MHz 束流，平均功率從數瓦升到數百瓦，鏡面熱凸起與偵測器飽和立即出現；反過來把超導腔的連續波負載估成脈衝模式，2 K 低溫系統在數分鐘內失壓。
若實驗只用平均脈衝能量與名義延遲，泵浦-探測資料被 50 fs 的到達時間抖動塗抹，100 fs 的動力學訊號消失；更糟的是時間戳記錯位一發，整批資料與診斷配對錯誤而無法事後修正。
pitfallsEn: Connecting 120 Hz-era optics and detectors directly to a 1 MHz beam raises average power from watts to hundreds of watts, and mirror thermal bumps and detector saturation appear at once; conversely, estimating the superconducting cavities' CW load as if pulsed lets the 2 K cryogenic system lose pressure within minutes.

If an experiment uses only average pulse energy and nominal delay, 50 fs of arrival jitter smears the pump-probe data and a 100 fs dynamic signal disappears; worse, a one-shot offset in time stamps mispairs an entire run with its diagnostics beyond later repair.

related.title: European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射
related.transfer: 可遷移「脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界」與「逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration" and "Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of European XFEL must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦SASE 自由電子雷射的增益、束流壓縮、單發診斷與 LCLS-II 超導升級；European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射則以突發模式超導直線加速、可變間隙 SASE 波盪器、掠射 X 光光學與 MHz 偵測器的系統工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on SASE gain, bunch compression, single-shot diagnostics and the LCLS-II superconducting upgrade; European XFEL centres on systems engineering of burst-mode superconducting acceleration, variable-gap SASE undulators, grazing-incidence X-ray optics and MHz detectors, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」與「1.3 GHz 超導直線加速器與脈衝列」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「MHz 偵測器：增益切換、記憶格與逐格校正」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)” and “1.3 GHz superconducting linac and pulse train”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to European XFEL, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "MHz detectors: gain switching, memory cells and per-cell calibration", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施
related.transfer: 可遷移「脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界」與「逐發診斷：脈衝能量、光譜與到達時間」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration" and "Shot-by-shot diagnostics: pulse energy, spectrum and arrival time" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of SPring-8 synchrotron facility must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦SASE 自由電子雷射的增益、束流壓縮、單發診斷與 LCLS-II 超導升級；日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施則以8 GeV 高能儲存環的硬 X 光取得、注入、束團純度與 SPring-8-II 降能升級為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on SASE gain, bunch compression, single-shot diagnostics and the LCLS-II superconducting upgrade; SPring-8 synchrotron facility centres on hard X-ray generation, injection, bunch purity and the SPring-8-II lower-energy upgrade of an 8 GeV ring, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「銅直線加速器（S 頻段，120 Hz）與超導直線加速器（1.3 GHz，連續波）」與「8 GeV 儲存環（1436 m，44 單元）」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「同調分率、繞射極限與亮度增益」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Copper linac (S-band, 120 Hz) and SC linac (1.3 GHz, CW)” and “8 GeV ring (1436 m, 44 cells)”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to SPring-8 synchrotron facility, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Coherent fraction, diffraction limit and brilliance gain", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: SLAC LCLS 自由電子雷射
history.text: SLAC 的 3 km 直線加速器於 1966 年啟用，原為高能物理設施；1992 年 Pellegrini 等人提出用其最後一段驅動 X 光自由電子雷射，LCLS 於 2006 至 2009 年建成，2009 年 4 月以 1.5 Å 首次出光，成為全球第一座硬 X 光自由電子雷射，重複率 120 Hz。LCLS-II 在隧道前段加裝 4 GeV 超導連續波直線加速器與兩支可變間隙波盪器，2023 年 9 月首次出光，重複率可達 1 MHz；LCLS-II-HE 將把超導直線加速器延伸到 8 GeV。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: SLAC's 3 km linac began operation in 1966 as a high-energy-physics machine; in 1992 Pellegrini and colleagues proposed driving an X-ray free-electron laser with its final section, and LCLS was built from 2006 to 2009, first lasing at 1.5 Å in April 2009 as the world's first hard X-ray FEL at 120 Hz. LCLS-II added a 4 GeV superconducting continuous-wave linac in the front of the tunnel and two variable-gap undulators, achieving first light in September 2023 with repetition rates up to 1 MHz; LCLS-II-HE will extend the superconducting linac to 8 GeV. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「脈衝式常溫加速與連續波超導加速的系統邊界」到「高平均功率下的機器保護與驗收」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "System boundaries of pulsed copper versus CW superconducting acceleration" through "Machine protection and acceptance at high average power" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
